sources.title: zeta-2.1: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: Yes. The base model uses the transformers library and standard PyTorch training. The zeta dataset documentation references DPO and SFT finetuning notebooks, suggesting you can apply the same finetuning techniques to zeta-2.1. You will need to format your training data in the SPM prompt format with proper markers and context.
